items.title: Tom Malone interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, May 3, 2023
items.q: I was arranger for the David Letterman show for 22 years.

ctx.x: That’s cool because I know Finale has some things that are quite annoying but to be in on the development of it you’re not going to get annoyances when you get the final product.

Well as far as I know, Finale is more the standard for the publishing business. And although Sibelius has some advantages too, and I have both of those softwares, but there’s always a deadline when I do an arrangement so I just always go back to Overture because I’m lightening fast on that. One night — I was arranger for the David Letterman show for 22 years. One night, we did — our basic schedule was we did the show from 4:30 to 5:30 PM and then it was broadcast at 11:30. Anyway, one night — the show’s over…
